title: a choice question with empty criteria is invalid in fake-jev v1
note: Derived from §39.2, not from §44. The observed upstream schema does not declare minProperties, but fake-jev rejects empty criteria deliberately: a choice with no legal answer cannot be deterministically served, and a one-hot distribution over an empty key set is not defined (§13.2). This is a documented divergence from upstream, not an accident.

journal._timestampOmitted: timestamp is diagnostic only (§8.6, §41.7) and is not asserted

conventions.comparison: parsed JSON values; object key order and insignificant number spelling 1 versus 1.0 are not significant (§44 preamble, §39.4)
conventions.messageSentinel: the literal string <not asserted> marks a field whose value the specification does not freeze; a runner MUST skip it
